data.name_ar: التأمين الصحي المدني - إدارة التأمين الصحي / وزارة الصحة
data.notes: Civil Health Insurance Program run by the MoH Health Insurance Administration (Civil Health Insurance Regulation No. 83/2004). Covers government employees, retirees and dependants, plus categories such as National Aid Fund families, people over 60, persons with disabilities, pregnant women, children under six, and voluntary individual/employer subscriptions (arts. 30-31). Treatment in MoH facilities; contracted private hospitals for some classes. Phones: first three from hia.gov.jo contact block, 065527024 is the hotline printed on HIA brochures. network_url is HIA's 'contracted private hospitals' list page.

data.name_ar: الخدمات الطبية الملكية - التأمين الصحي العسكري
data.notes: Military health insurance administered by the Royal Medical Services of the Jordan Armed Forces, covering military and security personnel, retirees and their families. Website confirmed reachable (title 'JRMS | HomePage') on 2026-10-24; phones not captured. Scheme description from jordan.gov.jo and the open-data dataset 'insured by the military health insurance system' (opendata.gov.jo).

Primary health care for registered Palestine refugees through UNRWA health centres in Jordan; hospitalisation reimbursement scheme administered by the MoH under an MoH-UNRWA agreement (UNRWA press release, undated on un.org, c. 2006): refugee patients pay their 25% share (5% for special hardship cases) at the hospital. Current terms not verified.

Medical exemptions (treatment at public expense) for people outside civil, military and private insurance coverage. Per PM Bisher Khasawneh (Al-Mamlaka, 2023-03-14), the exemption mechanism was moved to be managed by the Public Service Office at the Royal Hashemite Court; budget JOD 70m + 25m for 2023. Current procedure and contact details not found.
